summary.content:
Today's selection covers 63 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 6 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Kevin Roose is AGI-pilled. Why aren’t you?
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
